title: Microsoft Office 365 Management Activity (o365:management:activity) Event
description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Office 365 (splunk_ta_o365) -- events from the Office 365 Management Activity API, ingested into sourcetype o365:management:activity. Content types (Audit.AzureActiveDirectory, Audit.Exchange, Audit.SharePoint, Audit.General, DLP.All) all share the Common Schema and then extend it with service-specific properties. This root schema defines the Common Schema plus the CIM-normalized fields the TA adds; the five content-type-specific field sets and composite event schemas live under $defs and are additive layers, not a strict discriminated union -- content_type is not guaranteed to be exposed by every modular input configuration, Workload does not map 1:1 to content type for Audit.General (a catch-all spanning many workloads), and DLP.All can appear under multiple workloads. Field presence, especially for Audit.General, varies significantly by Workload and Operation; this schema covers the commonly used/documented fields, not every nested complex type -- for the complete authoritative list refer to the official Microsoft documentation (Office 365 Management Activity API schema).
x-common-filter-examples: sourcetype=o365:management:activity content_type="Audit.AzureActiveDirectory"  # if the modular input exposes it

x-workload-to-content-type.typicalUseCases: Mailbox access, admin cmdlets, transport rules

x-recommended-searches: index=* sourcetype=o365:management:activity Workload=AzureActiveDirectory | stats count by Operation, ResultStatus
x-references: Office 365 Management Activity API schema (Microsoft docs)

Id.description: Unique identifier of the audit record (GUID).

RecordType.description: Type of operation. Not an exhaustive enum here -- see Microsoft's AuditLogRecordType reference for the full list. Values commonly seen for DLP.All: 11 = ComplianceDLPSharePoint, 13 = ComplianceDLPExchange, 33 = ComplianceDLPSharePointClassification, plus endpoint and on-premises scanner types.

CreationTime.description: When the audit record was generated (UTC).

Operation.description: Name of the activity or cmdlet.

UserType.description: Type of user. Documented values: 0=Regular, 1=Reserved, 2=Admin, 3=DcAdmin, 4=System, 5=Application, 6=ServicePrincipal, 7=CustomPolicy, 8=SystemPolicy, etc. -- not necessarily exhaustive.

Workload.description: Service where the activity occurred, e.g. AzureActiveDirectory, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, MicrosoftTeams, SecurityComplianceCenter, PowerBI, etc.

ResultStatus.description: Succeeded / PartiallySucceeded / Failed (or True/False for some Exchange events).

UserId.description: User or actor who performed the operation (UPN or object ID).

content_type.description: Content type label. Present only if the modular input exposes it -- not guaranteed on every event.

action.description: CIM-normalized action field added by the TA.

status.description: CIM-normalized status field added by the TA.

user.description: CIM-normalized user field added by the TA.

src_user.description: CIM-normalized src_user field added by the TA.

actorOrTarget.description: An actor or target reference (ID + Type).

aadFields.description: Additional fields for Audit.AzureActiveDirectory events. Workload is primarily AzureActiveDirectory; main schemas are Microsoft Entra ID Base, Account Logon, Secure STS Logon, and general Entra schema. Typical Operations: UserLoggedIn, UserLoginFailed, Add user., Update user., Delete user., Add member to role., Add service principal., Consent to application., Set company contact information., password-related events, etc. CIM mapping strength: very strong for Authentication and Change / Account_Management.

Actor.description: Array of actors (ID + Type) involved in the operation.

ActorIpAddress.description: Actor IP (sometimes used instead of/in addition to ClientIP).

ExtendedProperties.description: Array of Name/Value pairs (UserAgent, authentication method, error details, etc.).

exchangeFields.description: Additional fields for Audit.Exchange events. Workload is Exchange; main schemas are Exchange Admin, Exchange Mailbox, OWA Auth, plus some DLP/MIP overlap. Typical Operations: admin cmdlets (New-Mailbox, Set-Mailbox, Add-MailboxPermission, transport rules, etc.) and mailbox operations (MailItemsAccessed, Send, Create, Update, SoftDelete, HardDelete, MoveToDeletedItems, FolderBind, etc.). CIM mapping: strong for Email, Change, and some Data Access.

ExternalAccess.description: Whether the action was performed by an external user.

sharepointFields.description: Additional fields for Audit.SharePoint events. Workload values are SharePoint and OneDrive; main schemas are SharePoint Base, File Operations, List Operations, Sharing, and general SharePoint schema. Note: ObjectId (from the Common Schema) is often the full path or unique ID of the file/item for this content type. Typical Operations: FileAccessed, FileDownloaded, FileUploaded, FileDeleted, FileRenamed, FileMoved, FileCopied, FolderCreated, SharingSet, SharingRevoked, AnonymousLinkCreated, AccessRequestAccepted, list item operations, site collection admin changes, etc. CIM mapping: strong for Data Access, Change, and some Email (when sharing links are involved).

generalFields.description: Audit.General is the catch-all content type for workloads not covered by AzureActiveDirectory, Exchange, or SharePoint -- Workload values seen include MicrosoftTeams, SecurityComplianceCenter, PowerBI, MicrosoftForms, Yammer/Viva Engage, Stream, Dynamics365, Project, Planner, and others. It uses the Common Schema plus workload-specific extensions whose exact field names are not enumerated in the source dictionary this schema was generated from -- field presence varies significantly by Workload and Operation, so always combine with a Workload= filter in searches rather than relying on this schema alone. Useful cross-cutting fields when present: ApplicationId, ClientIP, UserId, ObjectId (all in the Common Schema), workload-specific objects (e.g. Team name, Channel name, Report ID, Policy ID -- exact field names vary by workload), and ExtendedProperties / ModifiedProperties for configuration changes.

ExtendedProperties.description: Array of Name/Value pairs, when present.

ModifiedProperties.description: Array of changed properties, when present.

dlpFields.description: Additional fields for DLP.All events. Can appear under multiple workloads (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Endpoint, etc.); main schema is the DLP schema extending the Common Schema. Special note: UserKey (Common Schema) is typically "DlpAgent". Operation is typically one of: DlpRuleMatch, DlpRuleUndo, DlpInfo. CIM mapping: mapped to the Data Loss Prevention data model (DLP_Incidents).

PolicyDetails.description: Array of matched policy information (PolicyId, PolicyName, Rules, etc.).

SensitiveInfoDetectionIsIncluded.description: Whether sensitive info details are present.

aadEvent.description: A Management Activity event with content_type Audit.AzureActiveDirectory: the Common Schema plus aadFields.

exchangeEvent.description: A Management Activity event with content_type Audit.Exchange: the Common Schema plus exchangeFields.

sharepointEvent.description: A Management Activity event with content_type Audit.SharePoint: the Common Schema plus sharepointFields.

generalEvent.description: A Management Activity event with content_type Audit.General: the Common Schema plus generalFields. This is the least strictly modeled branch given how much field presence varies by Workload -- see generalFields' description.

dlpEvent.description: A Management Activity event with content_type DLP.All: the Common Schema plus dlpFields.
